IMD_RADAR.geographic_coverage: Tamil Nadu Coastal & Inland Convective Corridor (12.0°N–14.5°N, 79.0°E–81.5°E)
IMD_RADAR.access_method: IMD Open Data Portal REST API / Local Staging Cache
IMD_RADAR.license_constraints: Government of India National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP)
IMD_RADAR.authentication: API Key header (IMD_API_KEY) in production; simulated/cached in dev
IMD_RADAR.historical_availability: Archived scans available for selected convective storm events (2020–2024)
IMD_RADAR.known_limitations: Ground clutter around urban Chennai; beam blockage along Western Ghats; occasional 20-40 min feed outages during severe cyclone squalls
IMD_RADAR.backup_source: INSAT-3D TIR cold cloud-top proxy + WRF NWP radar reflectivity diagnostic

INSAT_3D_SATELLITE.dataset: INSAT-3D / 3DR Imager Thermal Infrared Channel 1 (TIR-1: 10.8 µm)
INSAT_3D_SATELLITE.geographic_coverage: South Asia / Indian Ocean Synoptic Coverage (Full Disk)
INSAT_3D_SATELLITE.temporal_resolution: 15 minutes (Half-hourly rapid scan during tropical cyclones)
INSAT_3D_SATELLITE.access_method: MOSDAC (ISRO Meteorological and Oceanographic Satellite Data Archival Centre)
INSAT_3D_SATELLITE.license_constraints: ISRO / MOSDAC Academic & Research Data Policy
INSAT_3D_SATELLITE.authentication: MOSDAC Credentials for automated FTP/HTTPS pull
INSAT_3D_SATELLITE.known_limitations: Parallax shift near edges; cirrus anvil contamination obscuring boundary layer convection
INSAT_3D_SATELLITE.backup_source: Himawari-9 / EUMETSAT IODC public browse feeds

BLITZORTUNG_LIGHTNING.dataset: Total Lightning Strike Arrival Time Difference (TOA / ATD)
BLITZORTUNG_LIGHTNING.geographic_coverage: Global network with ~35 receiver stations covering Indian Subcontinent
BLITZORTUNG_LIGHTNING.temporal_resolution: 1 millisecond timestamp resolution, aggregated to 5-minute epochs
BLITZORTUNG_LIGHTNING.spatial_resolution: Station density dependent (~2–5 km localization accuracy)
BLITZORTUNG_LIGHTNING.license_constraints: Non-commercial community use only; requires raw sensor contribution or academic waiver
BLITZORTUNG_LIGHTNING.historical_availability: Archived stroke records accessible via Blitzortung archive APIs
BLITZORTUNG_LIGHTNING.known_limitations: Detection efficiency lower over open Bay of Bengal (> 200 km offshore); biased toward strong CG strokes over IC flashes

OPEN_METEO_NWP.dataset: Numerical Weather Prediction Soundings & Convective Diagnostics (ECMWF IFS / GFS)
OPEN_METEO_NWP.authentication: Keyless tier (subject to 10,000 calls/day rate limit)
OPEN_METEO_NWP.historical_availability: ERA5 reanalysis available back to 1940; operational forecasts back to 2022
OPEN_METEO_NWP.known_limitations: NWP cannot resolve sub-km convective updraft cores; provides synoptic boundary forcing only
